hypothesis: After synthetic validation of N2 as an adequate W2 component, a PRE-only adaptive mixture of C0 and frozen N2 may outperform fixed universal mixtures in the learnable-regime synthetic twin.
input_dataset: Learnable-regime Digital Twin v2 only. Design seed 20260924, 400 synthetic standard 7-rider races. Evaluation seed 20260925 was NOT ACCESSED because no design candidate qualified. No real/historical input.
prediction_method: 20 preregistered mappings w_hat=sigmoid(bias+slope*PRE_signal), exact truth pair excluded; C0_SCORE_PL and frozen N2_SPEC_ALIGNED_POSTERIOR_CONDITIONAL only. Baselines C0_ONLY, N2_ONLY, and fixed N2 mixture weights 0.05/0.25/0.50/0.75.
conclusion: No adaptive mapping beat the preregistered universal baselines. N2_ONLY was the lowest-KL universal baseline overall and in every LOW/MID/HIGH PRE-signal stratum, while all adaptive mixtures were worse. Evaluation was correctly left untouched. The next question is component specialization: whether N2 also dominates C0 under pure W0, making adaptive selection structurally unnecessary in the current synthetic construction.
follow_up: Preregister a synthetic component-specialization audit comparing C0 and frozen N2 directly on pure W0 and W2 across new disjoint seeds. Do not tune selector weights or access the untouched v7 evaluation seed.
